$comment: One row per real Turbo or Nx repo benched against its own tool. update-site.ts renders README.md's real-repo table and the site's benchmarks/real-repos page from it; each row's heading names its section in packages/vx/docs/benchmarks.md, where the harness and every number are recorded. Values are vx / theirs; a ** marks the side that wins when it is theirs.

rows.setup: `turbo()`; `turbo.json` inputs fixed so Turbo stops hashing its own outputs
rows.heading: Real repos re-measured (2026-09-27)
payloadcms/payload (45 `build` tasks, pnpm 10, Turbo 2.10.4)
rows.why: A tie within noise. On every hit vx stats all 14,430 recorded output files to prove they are intact; Turbo checks nothing on disk.

rows.setup: `turbo()` plus a bench output list (its `turbo.json` outputs are a negation glob `turbo()` runs uncached)
rows.heading: medusajs/medusa (83 `build` + `build:plugin` tasks, yarn 3, Turbo 1.13.4)
n8n-io/n8n (70 `build` tasks, pnpm 12, Turbo 2.9.18, Node 24)
rows.why: The cold build is `n8n-nodes-base#build`, 55 s alone, plus what fits around it; vx is 2.6% behind there.

rows.setup: `turbo()` plus a bench output list (`.next` minus its 110 `node_modules` symlinks)
rows.heading: calcom/cal.com (13 `build` tasks, yarn 3, Turbo 2.7.1, scope `@calcom/web...`)
unocss/unocss (Turbo 2.10.13, `turbo()`, `f05ee3a`)
rows.why: One task, `@unocss/vscode#build`, rewrites its own `README.md` input on every run. vx will not save a result whose input changed under it, so it reruns that task each time; the other 41 are a 160 ms no-op.

rows.setup: `turbo()` plus one `dependsOn` edge its `turbo.json` leaves implicit
rows.heading: vueuse/vueuse (Turbo 2.10.12, `turbo()`, `efdd69a`)
rows.why: Turbo restores this repo faster, and its no-op alternates: its key for one task flips between two values on consecutive runs, so every other no-op rebuilds (7.3–7.7 s).
